plasticity_rules.name: Pair-Based STDP
plasticity_rules.latex: \Delta w = \begin{cases} A_+ \exp(-\Delta t / \tau_+) & \text{if } \Delta t > 0 \\ -A_- \exp(\Delta t / \tau_-) & \text{if } \Delta t < 0 \end{cases}

plasticity_rules.name: Triplet STDP Rule
plasticity_rules.latex: \Delta w = r_1(t) \left( A_2^+ + A_3^+ r_2(t-\epsilon) \right) - o_1(t) \left( A_2^- + A_3^- o_2(t-\epsilon) \right)

plasticity_rules.name: Calcium-Based Plasticity
plasticity_rules.description: Plasticity driven by calcium concentration levels

plasticity_rules.name: Symmetric STDP
plasticity_rules.description: both pre and post-before-pre cause LTP

plasticity_rules.name: Asymmetric STDP
plasticity_rules.latex: \Delta w = A_+ e^{-\Delta t/\tau_+} - A_- e^{\Delta t/\tau_-}

plasticity_rules.name: Anti-Hebbian STDP
plasticity_rules.latex: \Delta w = -A_+ e^{-\Delta t/\tau_+} + A_- e^{\Delta t/\tau_-}

plasticity_rules.name: Mexican Hat STDP
plasticity_rules.latex: \Delta w = A_1 e^{-\Delta t^2/2\sigma_1^2} - A_2 e^{-\Delta t^2/2\sigma_2^2}
